time under each volatility or drawdown scale

risk_decision_rule.admissibility: Risk overlays are evaluated only after the no-control core has positive aggregate net Sharpe, at least four positive folds, positive pooled next-day IC, and at least four positive-IC folds.
risk_decision_rule.combined_policy_minimum_effect: Versus no control at the same costs, maximum drawdown and 1% daily expected shortfall must both improve; expected shortfall must improve by at least 10%; annualized return retention must be at least 70%; neither base- nor doubled-cost Sharpe may fall by more than 0.05; every mandatory regime and sleeve gate must remain satisfied.
risk_decision_rule.fallback: If combined fails, choose the least complex admissible individual control, otherwise no control. Tie breaks are lower maximum drawdown, lower turnover, then canonical policy ID.
risk_decision_rule.non_rescue: No control variant may turn a falsified core mechanism into an admissible family.

trial_accounting.rule: Every material cell is registered before execution; an exact already-registered cell may be reused but never omitted from the organizer accounting.
